'''Groundskeeper Jacoby''' is a [[human]] located in the [[Master's Cellar]] in [[Deadwind Pass]]. Still living to this day, he continues his work tending to the grounds around Karazhan, appearing only when not a living soul is looking and fleeing to the depths of the cellar to hide when the living linger.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|60+|The Mystery of Karazhan V}}</ref>

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Old Crypt Key]] for {{questlong|Alliance|60+|The Mystery of Karazhan V}} and {{questlong|Horde|60+|The Depths of Karazhan V}}.
